name: vocabulary-voice-tutor
description: A private, mobile-first English and German word and sentence tutor.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/domain && npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/observability && npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/web && npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/api
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/domain && npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/observability && npm run dev --workspace @vocabulary/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/domain && npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/observability && npm run dev --workspace @vocabulary/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/domain && npm run build --workspace @vocabulary/observability && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
